answer_1.quote: We propose an AdaMatch-based bidirectional LLM for Cyclic CXR-report generation (AdaMatch-Cyclic) to facilitate the bidirectional generation between CXR and reports.
answer_1.outputs: comprehensive free-text radiology reports and synthetic chest X-ray images

answer_2.quote: We assess CXR-to-report generation using BLEU (B), METEOR (M), and ROUGE-L (R-L), and report-to-CXR generation using FID and NIQE.
